title: NPD: 2 stabbed on N. Military Hwy. - NewsBreak
text:
By No media credit provided. ,
4 hours ago
NORFOLK, Va. (WAVY) — Two people were injured after being stabbed Wednesday at a Holiday Inn Express on North Military Highway in Norfolk, police said.
Both people were taken to the hospital, and one has life-threatening injuries, according to Norfolk Police, who said the call came in around 5:05 p.m.
Photos from the scene show crime tape at a Holiday Inn Express at 1157 N. Military Hwy., along with police vehicles and Norfolk Fire-Rescue at the location.
Norfolk Police are investigating the stabbing.
Check with WAVY.com for updates.
